datasets.name: HIV blood + colon atlas v8 (preview, public)
datasets.description: PREVIEW of the amfAR HIV blood and colon atlas, build blood_gut_v8 (scVI, batch key = library); integration is not final. PUBLIC, DE-IDENTIFIED derivative of 6 public deposits: no donor or specimen IDs, sex, age, CD4 or viral load; 'library' is a study-scoped code. Expression = log1p(CP10k) for the 3,000 HVGs + a standard immune marker panel. Graph = each cell's 10 strongest neighbours (display only). hiv_rna: 'HIV RNA detected' = >=1 HIV UMI against the deposit's own reference; 'not detected' includes latent cells (RNA, not provirus, is measured). Peterson cells were all cultured overnight; one arm also got PMA/ionomycin (see ex_vivo_treatment). PWOH = Frouard's 3 control donors and Wei 2023's donors without HIV. Wei 2023 cells without a per-cell HIV call are 'not evaluable'. Colon cells are Peterson's only (see compartment).
